cleva_policy: CLEVAのプラットフォーム全体の資料を作り、個別データセットは公開事例を確認して別資料とする。31タスク群を31データセットとみなさない。CLEVA系列はそれ以外の制作の後に回す。

scenarios.title: Core scenarios
scenarios.source_description: The scenarios where we evaluate all the models.

scenarios.title: Targeted evaluations
scenarios.source_description: Targeted evaluation of specific skills (e.g., knowledge, reasoning) and risks (e.g., disinformation, memorization/copyright).

scenarios.title: Question answering
scenarios.source_description: In question answering, given a question and (optionally, in open-book settings) a passage, the goal is to produce the answer. QA is a general format that captures a wide range of tasks involving varying levels of world and commonsense knowledge and reasoning abilities.

scenarios.title: Information retrieval
scenarios.source_description: In information retrieval, given a query and a set of candidate documents, the goal is to produce a ranking of the documents.

scenarios.title: Summarization
scenarios.source_description: In text summarization, given a piece of text (paragraph or document), the goal is to produce a much shorter summary.

scenarios.title: Sentiment analysis
scenarios.source_description: In sentiment classification, given a text (e.g., movie review), the goal is to predict the sentiment (positive or negative).

scenarios.title: Toxicity detection
scenarios.source_description: In toxicity detection, given a text, the goal is to predict whether the text has toxic content.

scenarios.title: Text classification
scenarios.source_description: Text classification is a general format that aims to classify text into a set of categories. This includes a wide range of classification tasks where the input is text.

scenarios.title: Aspirational scenarios
scenarios.source_description: Scenarios that we should support.

scenarios.title: Language
scenarios.source_description: Targeted evaluation of linguistic capabilities.

scenarios.title: Knowledge
scenarios.source_description: Targeted evaluation of knowledge (e.g. factual, cultural, commonsense).

scenarios.title: Reasoning
scenarios.source_description: Targeted evaluation of reasoning capabilities (e.g. mathematical, hierarchical).

scenarios.title: Harms
scenarios.source_description: Targeted evaluation of social harms (e.g., copyright, disinformation, social bias, toxicity).

scenarios.title: Efficiency
scenarios.source_description: Targeted evaluation of training and inference efficiency.

scenarios.title: Calibration
scenarios.source_description: Extended calibration metrics.

scenarios.title: Vary number of in-context examples
scenarios.source_description: Vary the number of in-context training examples.

scenarios.title: Vary multiple-choice strategy
scenarios.source_description: Vary the adapation strategy for multiple-choice questions.

scenarios.title: Vary prompting
scenarios.source_description: Vary the instructions and labels for input/output.

scenarios.title: Robustness to contrast sets
scenarios.source_description: Evaluating equivariance to semantics-altering perturbations

scenarios.title: Robustness to single types of perturbations
scenarios.source_description: Evaluating robsustness to a single perturbation at a time (e.g., typos, synonyms)

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) scenarios
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenarios for evaluating Chinese language models

scenarios.title: BoolQ
scenarios.source_description: The BoolQ benchmark for binary (yes/no) question answering [(Clark et al., 2019)](https://aclanthology.org/N19-1300/).

scenarios.title: NarrativeQA
scenarios.source_description: The NarrativeQA benchmark for reading comprehension over narratives [(Kočiský et al., 2017)](https://aclanthology.org/Q18-1023/).

scenarios.title: NaturalQuestions (closed-book)
scenarios.source_description: The NaturalQuestions [(Kwiatkowski et al., 2019)](https://aclanthology.org/Q19-1026/) benchmark for question answering based on naturally-occurring queries through Google Search. The input does not include the Wikipedia page with the answer.

scenarios.title: NaturalQuestions (open-book)
scenarios.source_description: The NaturalQuestions [(Kwiatkowski et al., 2019)](https://aclanthology.org/Q19-1026/) benchmark for question answering based on naturally-occurring queries through Google Search. The input includes the Wikipedia page with the answer.

scenarios.title: QuAC (Question Answering in Context)
scenarios.source_description: The QuAC benchmark for question answering in the context of dialogues [(Choi et al., 2018)](https://aclanthology.org/D18-1241/).

scenarios.title: HellaSwag
scenarios.source_description: The HellaSwag benchmark for commonsense reasoning in question answering [(Zellers et al., 2019)](https://aclanthology.org/P19-1472/).

scenarios.title: OpenbookQA
scenarios.source_description: The OpenbookQA benchmark for commonsense-intensive open book question answering [(Mihaylov et al., 2018)](https://aclanthology.org/D18-1260/).

scenarios.title: TruthfulQA
scenarios.source_description: The TruthfulQA benchmarking for measuring model truthfulness and commonsense knowledge in question answering [(Lin et al., 2022)](https://aclanthology.org/2022.acl-long.229/).

scenarios.title: MMLU (Massive Multitask Language Understanding)
scenarios.source_description: The Massive Multitask Language Understanding (MMLU) benchmark for knowledge-intensive question answering across 57 domains [(Hendrycks et al., 2021)](https://openreview.net/forum?id=d7KBjmI3GmQ).

scenarios.title: MS MARCO (regular track)
scenarios.source_description: The MS MARCO benchmark's regular track for passage retrieval in information retrieval [(https://microsoft.github.io/msmarco/)](https://microsoft.github.io/msmarco/).

scenarios.title: MS MARCO (TREC track)
scenarios.source_description: The MS MARCO benchmark's deep learning TREC track for passage retrieval in information retrieval [(https://trec.nist.gov)](https://microsoft.github.io/msmarco/).

scenarios.title: CNN/DailyMail
scenarios.source_description: The CNN/DailyMail benchmark for text summarization ([Hermann et al., 2015](https://papers.nips.cc/paper/2015/hash/afdec7005cc9f14302cd0474fd0f3c96-Abstract.html); [Nallapati et al.,2016](https://aclanthology.org/K16-1028/)).

scenarios.title: XSUM
scenarios.source_description: The XSUM benchmark for text summarization of BBC news articles [(Narayan et al., 2018)](https://aclanthology.org/D18-1206/).

scenarios.title: IMDB
scenarios.source_description: The IMDB benchmark for sentiment analysis in movie review [(Maas et al., 2011)](https://aclanthology.org/P11-1015/).

scenarios.title: RAFT (Real-world Annotated Few-Shot)
scenarios.source_description: The Real-world annotated few-shot (RAFT) meta-benchmark of 11 real-world text classification tasks [(Alex et al., 2021)](https://datasets-benchmarks-proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2021/hash/ca46c1b9512a7a8315fa3c5a946e8265-Abstract-round2.html).

scenarios.title: CivilComments
scenarios.source_description: The CivilComments benchmark for toxicity detection [(Borkan et al., 2019)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1903.04561.pdf).

scenarios.title: ICE (International Corpus of English)
scenarios.source_description: The International Corpus of English (ICE) drawn from English speakers from various places in the world, initiated by [Greenbaum (1991)](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/english-today/article/abs/ice-the-international-corpus-of-english/47808205394C538393C3FD8E62E5E701).

scenarios.title: The Pile
scenarios.source_description: The Pile corpus for measuring lanugage model performance across various domains [(Gao et al., 2020)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2101.00027.pdf).

scenarios.title: TwitterAAE
scenarios.source_description: The TwitterAAE corpus of [Blodgett et al. (2016)](https://aclanthology.org/D16-1120/) for measuring language model performance in tweets as a function of speaker dialect.

scenarios.title: TwitterAAE (AA)
scenarios.source_description: The TwitterAAE corpus of [Blodgett et al. (2016)](https://aclanthology.org/D16-1120/) for measuring language model performance on African-American-aligned Tweets.

scenarios.title: TwitterAAE (white)
scenarios.source_description: The TwitterAAE corpus of [Blodgett et al. (2016)](https://aclanthology.org/D16-1120/) for measuring language model performance on White-aligned Tweets.

scenarios.title: BLiMP (The Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for English)
scenarios.source_description: The Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for English (BLiMP) for measuring performance on linguistic phenomena using minimal pair design [(Warstadt et al., 2020)](https://aclanthology.org/2020.tacl-1.25/).

scenarios.title: WikiFact
scenarios.source_description: Scenario introduced in this work, inspired by [Petroni et al. (2019)](https://aclanthology.org/D19-1250/), to more extensively test factual knowledge.

scenarios.title: bAbI
scenarios.source_description: The bAbI benchmark for measuring understanding and reasoning [(Weston et al., 2015)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1502.05698.pdf).

scenarios.title: Dyck
scenarios.source_description: Scenario testing hierarchical reasoning through the Dyck formal languages [(Suzgun et al., 2019)](https://aclanthology.org/W19-3905/).

scenarios.title: Numerical reasoning
scenarios.source_description: Scenario introduced in this work to test numerical reasoning via symbolic regression.

scenarios.title: Synthetic reasoning (abstract symbols)
scenarios.source_description: Synthetic reasoning tasks defined using abstract symbols based on LIME [(Wu et al., 2021)](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v139/wu21c.html).

scenarios.title: Synthetic reasoning (natural language)
scenarios.source_description: Synthetic reasoning tasks defined using simple natural language based on LIME [(Wu et al., 2021)](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v139/wu21c.html).

scenarios.title: GSM8K (Grade school math word problems)
scenarios.source_description: The grade school math word problems dataset (GSM8K) for testing mathematical reasoning on grade-school math problems [(Cobbe et al., 2021)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2110.14168.pdf).

scenarios.title: MATH
scenarios.source_description: The MATH benchmark for measuring mathematical problem solving on competition math problems [(Hendrycks et al., 2021)](https://datasets-benchmarks-proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2021/hash/be83ab3ecd0db773eb2dc1b0a17836a1-Abstract-round2.html).

scenarios.title: MATH (chain-of-thought)
scenarios.source_description: The MATH benchmark for measuring mathematical problem solving on competition math problems with chain-of-thought style reasoning [(Hendrycks et al., 2021)](https://datasets-benchmarks-proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2021/hash/be83ab3ecd0db773eb2dc1b0a17836a1-Abstract-round2.html).

scenarios.title: APPS (Code)
scenarios.source_description: The APPS benchmark for measuring competence on code challenges [(Hendrycks et al., 2021)](https://datasets-benchmarks-proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2021/hash/c24cd76e1ce41366a4bbe8a49b02a028-Abstract-round2.html).

scenarios.title: HumanEval (Code)
scenarios.source_description: The HumanEval benchmark for measuring functional correctness for synthesizing programs from docstrings [(Chen et al., 2021)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.03374.pdf).

scenarios.title: LegalBench
scenarios.source_description: LegalBench is a large collaboratively constructed benchmark of legal reasoning. Five representative tasks are included here. See [(Guha et al, 2023)[https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.11462] for more details.

scenarios.title: LegalSupport
scenarios.source_description: Scenario introduced in this work to measure fine-grained legal reasoning through reverse entailment.

scenarios.title: LSAT
scenarios.source_description: The LSAT benchmark for measuring analytical reasoning on the Law School Admission Test (LSAT; [Zhong et al., 2021](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2104.06598.pdf)).

scenarios.title: MedQA
scenarios.source_description: MedQA is an open domain question answering dataset composed of questions from professional medical board exams ([Jin et al. 2020](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2009.13081.pdf)).

scenarios.title: WMT 2014
scenarios.source_description: WMT 2014 is a collection of machine translation datasets.

scenarios.title: LEXTREME
scenarios.source_description: A Multilingual Legal Benchmark for Natural Language Understanding

scenarios.title: LexGLUE
scenarios.source_description: A Benchmark Dataset for Legal Language Understanding in English

scenarios.title: BillSum
scenarios.source_description: The BillSum benchmark for legal text summarization ([Kornilova & Eidelmann, 2020](https://aclanthology.org/D19-5406/)).

scenarios.title: MultiLexSum
scenarios.source_description: The MultiLexSum benchmark for legal text summarization ([Shen et al., 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.10883)).

scenarios.title: EurLexSum
scenarios.source_description: The EurLexSum benchmark for legal text summarization ([Aumiller et al., 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13448)).

scenarios.title: Data imputation
scenarios.source_description: Scenario from [Mei et al. (2021)](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9458712/) that tests the ability to impute missing entities in a data table.

scenarios.title: Entity matching
scenarios.source_description: Scenario from Magellan [(Konda et al., 2016)](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.14778/3007263.3007314) that tests the ability to determine if two entities match.

scenarios.title: Copyright (text)
scenarios.source_description: Scenario introduced in this work to measure copyright and memorization behavior for books, based off of [Carlini et al. (2021)](https://www.usenix.org/biblio-11958).

scenarios.title: Copyright (code)
scenarios.source_description: Scenario introduced in this work to measure copyright and memorization behavior for code, based off of [Carlini et al. (2021)](https://www.usenix.org/biblio-11958).

scenarios.title: Disinformation (reiteration)
scenarios.source_description: Scenario from [Buchanan et al. (2021)](https://cset.georgetown.edu/publication/truth-lies-and-automation/) that tests the ability to reiterate disinformation content.

scenarios.title: Disinformation (wedging)
scenarios.source_description: Scenario from [Buchanan et al. (2021)](https://cset.georgetown.edu/publication/truth-lies-and-automation/) that tests the ability to generate divisive and wedging content.

scenarios.title: BBQ (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering)
scenarios.source_description: The Bias Benchmark for Question Answering (BBQ) for measuring social bias in question answering in ambiguous and unambigous context [(Parrish et al., 2022)](https://aclanthology.org/2022.findings-acl.165/).

scenarios.title: BOLD (Bias in Open-Ended Language Generation Dataset)
scenarios.source_description: The Bias in Open-Ended Language Generation Dataset (BOLD) for measuring biases and toxicity in open-ended language generation [(Dhamala et al., 2021)](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3442188.3445924).

scenarios.title: RealToxicityPrompts
scenarios.source_description: The RealToxicityPrompts dataset for measuring toxicity in prompted model generations [(Gehman et al., 2020)](https://aclanthology.org/2020.findings-emnlp.301/).

scenarios.title: Synthetic efficiency
scenarios.source_description: Scenario introduced in this work to better understand inference runtime performance of various models.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) closed book question answering
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Closed-book question answering task comprises three subtasks. One is for the medical domain, another for open-domain, and the last measures if a model generates truthful answers.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) summarization
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Summarize a dialogue between a customer representative and a customer.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) text classification
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: This scenario has two subtasks. Classify if an utterance is humorous and identify news topic based on its title.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) translation
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario for measuring the translation quality between Chinese and English.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) data to text generation
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Generate a product description based on structured data containing various product properties.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) dialogue generation
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Task-oriented dialogue between a user and a system.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) opinion mining
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Extract the target of an opinion.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) paraphrase generation
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Generate a paraphrase of a given sentence.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) paraphrase identification
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Identify if two sentences, from a dialogue or from the finance domain, share the same meaning.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) reading comprehension
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Answer a multiple-choice question based on a given paragraph.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) sentiment analysis
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Chinese sentiment analysis for product reviews.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) language modeling
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario for measuring language model performance across various domains (wikipedia and news).

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) pinyin transliteration
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that asks the model to translate between Chinese and Pinyin.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) classical Chinese understanding
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario for evaluating the understanding of classical Chinese by selecting the appropriate classical Chinese translation for a given modern Chinese sentence.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) coreference resolution
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario for testing models on solving coreference resolution problems (the winograd schema challenge).

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) intent understanding
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Tests whether the model could capture the writing intention of the authors after reading an article.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) subject knowledge
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario inspired by [Petroni et al. (2019)](https://aclanthology.org/D19-1250/) to extensively test factual knowledge in Chinese. It contains 13 subjects and a general domain.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) cultural knowledge
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario for evaluating models' understanding of Chinese culture. It has a Chinese-idiom-focused subtask.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) reasoning primitive
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario focused on primitive reasoning, including dyck language continuation, variable substitution, pattern induction, and pattern matching.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) deductive reasoning
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that gauges model's ability to reason deductive arguments. It includes a modus tollens subtask.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) inductive reasoning
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that tests models' ability to conclude rules from demonstrations and apply them to unseen test instances.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) code synthesis
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario for measuring functional correctness for synthesizing programs from Chinese docstrings.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) commonsense reasoning
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that tests models' commonsense reasoning ability. There are two subtasks: textual entailment and commonsense question answering.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) mathematical reasoning
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that tests models' mathematical reasoning ability with chain-of-thought style reasoning. It contains a math word problem solving subtask.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) conceptual generalization
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that assesses whether models could generalize physical relations to a synthetic grid world.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) toxicity detection
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Ask models about the offensiveness of the given text.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) bias
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that gauges bias of four demographic categories in dialogues, including race, gender, region, and occupation.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) copyright
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that measures copyright and memorization behavior for Chinese books and code, based off of [Carlini et al. (2021)](https://www.usenix.org/biblio-11958).

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) fact checking
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that lets models identify whether the given fact is true to test their factuality.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) instruction following
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that examines whether models could follow human instructions, mainly uncommon ones. It contains two subtasks: 'redefine' and 'pattern_matching_suppression'.

scenarios.title: CLEVA (Chinese) mathematical calculation
scenarios.status: CLEVA系列として最後に着手
scenarios.source_description: Scenario that evaluates the calculation ability of models. It has four subtasks: three-digit addition, three-digit subtraction, two-digit multiplication, and significant figures.

scenarios.title: Data-to-text generation
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we prioritize user-facing tasks in our core scenarios, but don't implement data-to-text generation. Could be implemented via WebNLG, E2E, ToTTo, etc.

scenarios.title: Fact verification
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we prioritize user-facing tasks in our core scenarios, but don't implement fact verification. Could be implemented via FEVER.

scenarios.title: Copywriting
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we prioritize user-facing tasks in our core scenarios, but don't implement tasks that have not been historically studied in the NLP research community like (ad) copywriting.

scenarios.title: Story generation
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we prioritize user-facing tasks in our core scenarios, but don't implement more creative and interactive tasks like story generation.

scenarios.title: Biomedical scenarios
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we implement scenarios from common domains in NLP research, neglecting various domains where language technologies could provide significant value.

scenarios.title: Clinical scenarios
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we implement scenarios from common domains in NLP research, neglecting various domains where language technologies could provide significant value.

scenarios.title: Financial scenarios
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we implement scenarios from common domains in NLP research, neglecting various domains where language technologies could provide significant value.

scenarios.title: Customer services scenarios
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we implement scenarios from common domains in NLP research, neglecting various domains where language technologies could provide significant value.

scenarios.title: Educational scenarios
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we implement scenarios from common domains in NLP research, neglecting various domains where language technologies could provide significant value.

scenarios.title: Very recent scenarios
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we implement scenarios using standard NLP datasets. However, to test temporal generalization as the world and language change, we should implement scenarios with very recent data (e.g., current world events) like StreamingQA.

scenarios.title: Scenarios involving historic data
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we implement scenarios using standard NLP datasets, which predominantly are from post-Internet and contemporary society. However, to test temporal generalization for using models in the digital humanities for historic data, we should implement scenarios with significantly older data (e.g., text from 1800s).

scenarios.title: Scenarios involving non-native speakers
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we implement scenarios of an unknown composition of native and non-native English speakers. We should implement scenarios to ensure coverage of language from non-native English speakers.

scenarios.title: Scenarios involving data from marginalized demographics in non-US English-speaking regions
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, we ensure some coverage of language based on US-centric demographic groups, including marginalized groups. We should implement scenarios to ensure coverage of other socially-relevant groups beyond US demographics (e.g., caste in India).

scenarios.title: Scenarios with user-facing tasks on English dialects
scenarios.status: 対象データセットの具体化が必要
scenarios.source_description: Currently, evaluate performance on English dialects via language modeling (e.g., TwitterAAE, ICE), but it would be good to implement user-facing tasks for these dialects.
